case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparent view of your cost structure. We value the long-standing cooperation and want to renew the agreement on a solid basis.

Our own data shows a different picture:

Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

With a longer contract term and binding volumes, we have prepared three options. Option A answers a preference for planning security with the shortest payment term, while Option C gives you the longest payment term. All three are structured to be easy to take to your pricing committee:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 412.02; payment 14 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 413.30; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 414.51; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

If your approval needs a summary or further data from us, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. While we acknowledge your historical data, our current policy restricts base price reductions, meaning we can only move on price in exchange for improved terms.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. We are pleased to build on your Option A, accepting the 24-month contract and 14-day payment terms to support your planning security. In exchange for these terms, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 427.11.

Our current Angebot is a price of €429.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €427.11 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €427.11 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your reply and for taking our price history into account. We understand that price movements are tightly governed on your side, and we appreciate your openness to talk about terms instead.

We stay firm on price, but we can meet you on other terms. The options below are set out so they can go straight to your pricing committee:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 419.92; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.43; payment 14 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.46; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Each option answers your wish for planning security with a long contract and a binding volume, and Option B also offers the fast payment you mentioned. If your approval needs anything further from us, such as a forecast breakdown, please tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Which volume can you commit to?

Our pricing follows our approval process.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
